connectionPaletteHint: ↑ ↓ to browse · Enter to add · Esc to cancel
resourceHint: Updates every 2 seconds. CPU shows activity across all cores and applications on the server machine. RAM shows total physical memory minus available memory; reclaimable caches count as available.
loginDescription: Sign in with your individual instance account.
passwordHint: At least 12 characters. Share the initial password privately.
loginHint: On first launch, sign in with the username admin and the password printed by the server.
name: Name
projectsDescription: Choose a project to continue building your pipeline.
noProjectsDescription: Create a project from scratch or explore the example to get started.
projectStartingPoint: Choose how to start your project
emptyProjectDescription: Start with a blank canvas and build a pipeline with your own data.
exampleDescription: The Northstar pipeline with its sample data.
importArchiveDescription: Recreate a project from a ZIP downloaded from Duckpad.
projectImported: Project imported. Its archive does not include everything it needs to run:
importMissingConnections: Connections that are not available to this project. An instance administrator can create them or grant them in the project settings.
importMissingFiles: Nodes that read uploaded or absolute server files. Upload these files again or choose files from an available connection.
relinkTemplateHint: This discards the local code and uses the current original template. Parameters and connections are kept.
dragHint: Drag a node onto the canvas
downloadProjectHint: Download the saved project files from this branch.
saveBeforeDownload: Save your changes before downloading the project.
createVariablesFileHint: Declare project variables in a new variables.json file.
variablesIntro: Versioned with this branch in variables.json. Values can differ per environment; switching environments never commits or runs anything.
variableCountOne: 1 variable · values shown for every environment, {environment} is active
variablesCount: {count} variables · values shown for every environment, {environment} is active
variablesNotSecret: Variables are visible in compiled SQL, run history and Git. Keep credentials in connections.
noVariablesHint: Declare a value once, give it a value per environment if needed, and bind node parameters to it or reference it in expressions.
choiceOptionsRequired: A choice needs distinct, non-empty options without parentheses.
unknownEnvironment: not an environment of this instance
variableEditorHint: Readers can view variables. Editors save changes as one commit.
impactNone: No value changes: results stay valid.
impactUnused: No node uses this variable, so no result becomes stale.
impactStale: Saving marks {nodes} as stale in {environments}. Nothing runs automatically.
impactStaleDescendant: Saving marks {nodes} and 1 descendant as stale in {environments}. Nothing runs automatically.
impactStaleDescendants: Saving marks {nodes} and {count} descendants as stale in {environments}. Nothing runs automatically.
renameVariableHint: The declaration and every reference in the flow change in one commit. Results stay valid.
saveBeforeRename: Save or discard your changes before renaming.
deleteVariableHint: Delete {name} from variables.json? The change is saved as one commit.
deleteUsedVariable: Unbind every parameter and remove every expression reference that uses this variable before deleting it.
discardVariableHint: This variable has unsaved changes. Discard them?
invalidVariableName: Use lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.
variableExists: A variable with this name already exists.
invalidVariablesFile: variables.json is invalid. Correct it in the Code tab first.
secretVariableWarning: This name looks like a credential. Variables are visible in Git, compiled SQL and run history; keep secrets in a connection.
undeclaredVariableUsed: {name} is used by {nodes} but is not declared.
branchNameHint: Use a complete name, such as experiment/my-change. A branch name cannot end with '/'.
invalidBranchName: Enter a valid branch name, such as experiment/my-change. Branch names cannot end with '/'.
branchLatestHint: Start from the latest saved version of this branch when you create the new branch.
branchHistoryHint: Choose a saved version below. Your new branch will start from that version.
branchReferenceHint: Use a branch name, tag or commit available in this project.
branchNoRevisions: No matching versions. Try another search or load more history.
noResultHint: Run this node and its ancestors to materialize a preview.
snapshotHint: Materialized at execution time. Refresh source data with a manual run.
staleHint: This is the last successful result. Recompute to explore lineage.
staleVariable: Variable {name} changed in {environment}: {before} → {after}. Run to refresh.
lineageInterrupted: This exploration was interrupted by recalculation or an edit. Select a cell in a new valid result.
lineageCircularReference: A circular lineage reference cannot be displayed.
compileHint: Compiling does not run the pipeline.
createVariableHint: The variable starts with the current value, and the parameter is bound to it in the same save: results stay valid.
variablePickerHint: Values follow the selected environment. Edit them in the Variables tab.
noExpressionVariables: No variable matches. Expressions can use text, number, boolean, date and choice variables.
variableNotInExpressions: {type} variables cannot be used inside expressions.
unbindVariable: Use a fixed value instead of {name}
undeclaredVariable: This variable is not declared in variables.json.
incompatibleVariable: The type of this variable does not suit this parameter.
sharedTemplateHint: Changes affect every instance of this local definition in the current branch.
sharedComponentHint: You are editing a shared component definition in this branch.
connectionIdentifierHint: Stable identifier used by projects. It cannot be changed after creation.
connectionAlreadyExists: A connection with this identifier already exists. Choose another identifier.
connectionMissing: This connection no longer exists. Close this form and create a new connection.
catalogHint: Shared by all projects. Settings and secrets stay outside project Git history.
secretHint: Stored outside Git. Leave the masked value to keep the existing secret.
localPreferences: Theme and language are saved in this browser and shared by accounts using it.
immutableTagHint: Tags mark a tested version. They cannot be moved or deleted. To correct a version, create a new tag.
jobsHint: Run a reviewed version in a dedicated environment and inspect its results.
noJobs: No Jobs yet. A project admin can create one.
jobTagMoved: The tag now points to a different commit. This Job keeps running its pinned commit.
jobTargetUnavailable: The target reference is unavailable. A tag Job keeps its pinned commit while that commit remains available.
deleteJobHint: Delete this Job? Its runs and results remain available in History.
jobSlugHint: Unique on this instance and permanent. Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
jobScopeHint: Leave empty for the whole project, or enter a node ID (component::node for a nested node). Its upstream nodes also run.
jobCompareHint: Review the changes, including variable values, before confirming. Open results keeps showing the last run until the next launch.
jobReadOnly: Job results are read-only. Launch and manage this version from Jobs.
operatorNotice: Operator access: run Jobs from the Jobs page. Branches are read-only.
metadataOnly: Historical records contain metadata only. Restarting clears in-memory previews and lineage.
restoreRevision: Open revision in a new branch
conflictHint: Both proposals are preserved. Choose a version or edit a combined result.
invalidHint: Invalid content is saved and versioned. Correct the files to enable execution.
fileHint: UI and file edits share the same source of truth. Every save is automatically committed, including invalid content.
documentationPlaceholder: Describe the meaning, source, rules and assumptions…
importHint: Copies definitions and nested dependencies. Future changes in the source project do not affect your copy.
noNodesHint: Add a source from the palette, then connect transformations.
emptyDocumentation: Add context that travels with your pipeline in README.md. Markdown is supported.
aboutText: Duckpad is a local SQL workspace powered by DuckDB, React Flow and Python. All computation is manual; your project files are automatically versioned.
exposedHint: JSON map of parameter names to type, default and internal targets. See the example components.
cancelRunHint: Cancellation waits for active SQL and cleanup. Completed external writes are not undone.
schemaHint: Connect and run the input nodes to see their columns.
advancedExpressionHint: The generated SQL expressions below remain editable. Save parameters when ready.
resizeHint: Drag or use arrow keys. Double-click to reset.
unexpectedError: Something went wrong. Reload the page to continue.
usersDescription: Manage individual accounts and instance access.
instanceRolesHint: Instance admins manage all accounts, connections and projects. Members only see their projects.
serviceAccountHint: Service accounts use API tokens only. They are instance Members and can be project Readers or Operators.
deactivateHint: This account will lose access immediately. Project memberships are retained:
projectAccessHint: Private by default. Only participants and instance admins can access this project.
project_reader_hint: View the flow, SQL, history and existing results. No editing or execution.
project_operator_hint: View the project and results; run, cancel and rerun Jobs. No editing or ad hoc runs.
project_editor_hint: Edit content and run, cancel or export the pipeline. Cannot manage access or delete the project.
project_admin_hint: Manage participants, change roles and delete the project, in addition to editing and execution.
lastAdminHint: Each project must keep at least one active administrator.
authorizedConnectionsHint: Only instance admins can authorize connections. Saving clears cached results; stop active executions first.
deleteProjectHint: Permanently delete the project, its branches, uploads and execution history.
confirmRemoveAccess: Remove project access for this participant?
passwordChangeHint: At least 12 characters. All sessions will end; sign in again afterward.
readerNotice: Read-only access · You can inspect the flow, SQL, history and existing results.
readerNoResult: An editor or admin must run this pipeline before results are available.
noProcessingImpact: No processing or wiring changes. Layout and names do not imply changed output values.
staticImpactHint: Static dependencies only. Schemas and output values are unresolved. No sources were read and no pipeline was run.
reviewMergeHint: Review the proposed changes and field conflicts before applying. Both branch histories are preserved. Changed heads or pending edits require a new review.
gitReaderHint: Readers can inspect comparisons and history. An editor role is required for Git mutations.
remoteAdminHint: A project administrator must configure origin and the upstream branch mapping.
configureOriginHint: Configure origin before fetching or publishing.
mappingRequired: Choose an explicit upstream branch mapping in remote configuration.
fetchFirst: Fetch first to verify the remote state.
fetchPullHint: Fetch updates remote knowledge only. Incoming review uses the displayed fetched head. Applying a pull never pushes; publishing is a separate action.
resolveBeforeApply: Choose a value for every unresolved field.
fixBeforeApply: Correct the reported definitions on the source or destination branch, then start a new review.
removeIntegratedBranch: Remove integrated branch and its worktree:
recovery_diverged: Both branches have new commits. Review and apply a pull, then review publication.
recovery_unrelated: These histories have no common ancestor. Choose a related remote branch; automatic replacement is unavailable.
recovery_unverified: Save a branch mapping and fetch to verify origin.
recovery_remote_deleted: The previously fetched branch was deleted. Review publication and explicitly choose recreation if intended.
ssoDescription: Connect an identity provider to this instance. Local password sign-in remains available for recovery.
ssoSecretSaved: A secret is stored. Leave blank to keep it. Enter a new secret when changing the issuer or client ID.
ssoSecretRequired: Enter the confidential client secret from your identity provider.
ssoCallbackHint: Register this exact redirect URI with your provider. HTTPS is required except on loopback.
ssoAllowSignup: Create member accounts on first SSO sign-in
ssoAccessHint: New accounts have no access to existing private projects. Restrict who can use this client at your provider, then manage project membership in Duckpad.
ssoSaved: SSO settings saved. Existing SSO sessions have been signed out.
ssoPasswordManaged: This account signs in through SSO. Manage its password at the identity provider.
ssoFailed: Single sign-on failed or expired. Try again, or use your local account and check the SSO configuration.
ssoLocalLogin: Or sign in with a local account
instanceSettingsDescription: Shared configuration for all projects and users. Only instance administrators can make changes.
userSettingsDescription: Manage your preferences and account security.
apiTokensHint: Authenticate API requests with a bearer token and your account’s permissions.
apiTokenShownOnce: Copy this token now. It will not be shown again.
apiTokenExpiryHint: Optional. Leave empty for no expiration; 90 days is suggested.
revokeApiTokenHint: Revoke this token? Clients using it will lose access immediately.
instanceEnvironmentsHint: Manage the environments available to all projects and connections.
routeNotFoundHint: This address does not match a page.
routeUnavailableHint: This page no longer exists or you do not have access to it.
leavePageHint: You have unsaved changes. Leave this page and discard them?
environmentIdentifierHint: Stable identifier used by connections and execution history. It cannot be changed after creation.
environmentConfirmationHint: Ask for confirmation before each pipeline or node run from the workspace.
environmentConnectionHint: Configure connection values for this environment in Connections before running.
deleteEnvironmentHint: This removes the environment and its connection values. Execution history is kept. Stop active runs before deleting.
confirmRunHint: This environment requires confirmation before every run. Start the following execution?
variablesRecordedHint: These values are recorded with the run in its history.
unsignedExtensionsHint: Native extensions run code on the server. Enable this only for binaries you trust; it disables extension signature checks for this instance.
extensionSettingsApplyHint: Stop active runs before changing this option. Saving a change clears current results; run your pipelines again. No server restart is needed.
extensionDownloadHint: Use any computer with Internet access, including Windows or macOS. The download targets the Duckpad server; you do not need DuckDB on the downloading computer.
extensionCustomHint: Get a compatible binary from its publisher. Enable unsigned extensions below before importing an unsigned build.
extensionImportHint: Choose a .duckdb_extension or .duckdb_extension.gz file (64 MiB maximum). Duckpad checks it locally without Internet access. Stop active runs first; importing replaces this extension and clears current results. No server restart is needed.
extensionImported: Extension imported. Activate it in your project’s Extensions tab or run a pipeline whose connector requires it.
instanceSearchHint: Find projects, open branches, and nodes by name or ID. Only projects you can access are searched.
searchMore: More matches available. Refine your search.
searchIncomplete: Some project files could not be searched.
searchTargetMissing: This node has moved or been deleted. Search again.
lineageContextHint: These values explain row selection or comparison. They are not necessarily inputs to the calculation.
lineageNoInputs: This step has no contributing input cells.
lineageLimitedHint: Tracing stops here because this calculation cannot be fully explained.
lineageAverageReason: Total of the {count} contributing values divided by their count.
lineageMinimumReason: Smallest value in the group. The inputs show all {count} matching cells.
lineageMaximumReason: Largest value in the group. The inputs show all {count} matching cells.
lineageDistinctCountReason: Counts {count} distinct values; repeated values count once.
lineageInputsReason: The connected inputs are used in this calculation.
exportNotRun: Run this export successfully to download its file.
exportRunning: Export execution is in progress. The file will be available when it finishes.
exportFailed: The latest execution did not complete successfully. Run the export again.
exportStale: Inputs or settings have changed. Run the export again to download current data.
exportMissing: The exported file is missing or unavailable. Run the export again.
exportUnsupported: This destination does not produce a downloadable file.
exportChanged: A newer export is available. Review the result and download again.
selectColumnsHint: Only listed columns are kept, in this order. Conversions fail on invalid values; previous results remain stale.
cleanValuesHint: Operations run in this order: trim text, parse as DATE, then replace nulls. Other columns and values are preserved.
invalidColumnSettings: Invalid saved column settings. Repair the node parameters in Code.
missingSourceColumn: Source column is missing. Run the upstream node and choose an available column.
invalidOutputName: Enter a nonempty name without control characters.
duplicateOutputName: Output names must be unique, ignoring letter case.
dateFormatHint: Example: %d/%m/%Y for 31/12/2026. Invalid dates or formats fail the run.
replacementTypeHint: Enter a value in the resulting type (YYYY-MM-DD for parsed dates). Empty text stays empty; text such as NULL is literal.
noCleaning: No operations configured. All input values are preserved.
chooseOutputColumns: Choose at least one output column.
textOperationTypeHint: Trim and date parsing require text (VARCHAR). Use Select columns to convert the source type first.
gitAuthenticationHint: SSH origins use the personal SSH key of the person who fetches or publishes (User settings), only on hosts that the instance trusts. HTTPS origins can only read public repositories. Keep tokens and passwords out of URLs. Configuration is shared across project worktrees and is never committed.
confirmGitOrigin: Use your SSH key for this origin?
useSshKeyForOrigin: Use my key for this URL
gitConsentDescription: Duckpad will connect to this repository with your personal SSH key. The branches, commits and project files that your key can read become visible to every member of this project, and your publications use your account. Confirm only if you expected this URL.
gitConsentRenewal: Duckpad asks again whenever a project administrator changes the origin.
sshKeyDescription: Duckpad uses this key, and only this key, when you fetch or publish a project over SSH. Add its public key to your account on your Git host, such as Bitbucket, GitHub or GitLab. The private key never leaves this instance.
sshPublicKeyHint: Add this line to the SSH keys of your Git host account.
regenerateSshKeyWarning: Duckpad creates a new key pair and the current key stops working immediately. Replace the public key on your Git host before synchronizing again.
deleteSshKeyWarning: Duckpad deletes your key pair. You cannot fetch or publish over SSH until you generate a new key and add it to your Git host. Also remove the old public key from your Git host.
noSshKey: You do not have an SSH key yet. Generate one to fetch and publish projects over SSH.
gitHostsDescription: Projects synchronize only with origins on these hosts. Each SSH connection verifies the host key listed here and authenticates with the key of the account that triggers it. The server's own SSH keys, agent and Git credentials are never used.
trustedHostKeysHint: One known_hosts line per key, for example from ssh-keyscan. Check each fingerprint against the one that your Git host publishes. Write [host]:port for a port other than 22.
allowedOriginPrefixesHint: Optional, one per line, ending with / or :, for example git@bitbucket.org:my-workspace/. When the list is not empty, every origin must start with one of these prefixes. HTTPS origins always require a prefix and can only read public repositories.
noTrustedHosts: No trusted host yet. Projects cannot synchronize over SSH.
projectExtensionsHint: Enable DuckDB functions directly in SQL models. Requirements and their origins are saved with this branch and included when sharing or exporting the project.
projectExtensionsInvalid: Correct extensions.json in Code before editing requirements here.
projectExtensionsStop: Wait for the active execution to finish before changing extensions.
projectExtensionDuplicate: This extension is already listed in the project.
projectExtensionRequired: This project still requires the extension. Execution is blocked until a compatible binary is available.
projectExtensionAskAdmin: Download the server binary and ask an instance administrator to import it.
projectExtensionsEmpty: No project extensions yet. Add a name and choose its origin to get started.
projectExtensionsOffline: Downloads target the server runtime, even from a browser on another OS. Import binaries in Instance settings → Extensions, then return here and refresh. Activation and subsequent execution use local binaries without Internet access.
importExtensionRequirements: This project requires DuckDB extensions. Their binaries are not included in the archive. Open the project’s Extensions tab to check availability and arrange any missing imports.
assistantSettingsHint: Connect a provider, choose the models people can use, then enable the assistant. Conversations belong only to their author.
assistantDataHint: When disabled, previews, lineage values and run messages are withheld. Saved code, documentation and variables can still be sent to the provider.
assistantKeySaved: Leave blank to keep the saved key. Changing the base URL requires a new key.
assistantKeyHint: Optional: only if your server requires one. Keys are never returned to the browser.
assistantLauncherHint: Drag to move (or Alt + arrow keys)
assistantDifferentBranch: Your next message will start a conversation in this project and branch.
assistantWelcomeHint: Ask about the project or request a change to the flow, SQL, documentation or variables. Each saved change can be undone.
assistantQuickPromptsHint: Optional buttons offered when a conversation starts. Default prompts follow the interface language until you customize this list.
assistantOptimizePrompt: Review every node in the workflow and look for possible optimizations or groupings without making any individual node too complex.
assistantDebugPrompt: Inspect the latest run in this environment, explain its errors and data-test results, and compare it with the preceding successful run. Do not run anything without my confirmation.
assistantExplainPrompt: Help me understand a value in the selected node. Ask which row and column I mean, then use the output preview, lineage and upstream SQL to explain its calculation.
assistantIrreversibleExports: This run includes exports or external writes. Their effects cannot be undone.
assistantAnswerConfirmation: Answer the run confirmation above to continue this conversation.
assistantDebugContext: Help me debug this error. Run: {run}. Node: {node}. Read the diagnostics and executed SQL before suggesting a fix.
assistantRunEntryPoint: Started from the AI assistant after user approval
assistantErrorApprovalUsed: This run request has already been answered.
assistantErrorRunChanged: The run configuration changed. Request a new run and review its confirmation.
assistantDataOn: Data reading is enabled for this instance.
assistantDataOff: Only code and metadata can be read.
assistantMoreChanges: Open Compare versions to see all changes.
assistantReadOnly: Read-only: your project role does not allow changes.
assistantErrorKey: The provider refused the API key. Ask an instance administrator to check it.
assistantErrorQuota: The provider quota or rate limit was reached. Try again later.
assistantErrorModel: The model is unavailable or does not support this request. Check the configured model.
assistantErrorNetwork: Could not reach the assistant provider. Check the connection and model, then try again.
assistantErrorTimeout: The assistant timed out. Try a narrower question.
assistantErrorLimit: The assistant reached its limit for this turn. Try a narrower question.
assistantErrorPolicy: Data reading is now disabled. Start a new conversation to keep previous values private.
assistantErrorChanged: Assistant settings changed. Start a new turn.
assistantErrorProvideKey: Provide an API key for this provider
assistantErrorInvalidEdit: The proposed changes are invalid. Review the project diagnostics.
assistantErrorConflict: Resolve the pending project conflict before making another change.
assistantErrorWait: Wait for the assistant response before undoing.
assistantErrorUndoBranch: Open the original conversation branch before undoing.
assistantProvidersHint: Keys stay on the server. Once saved, Duckpad only shows that a key exists.
assistantBaseUrlHint: Address as seen from the Duckpad server, usually ending with /v1.
assistantKeyPlaceholderSaved: Saved key hidden — type a new one to replace it
assistantKeyRequired: Required. It is stored on the server and never shown again.
assistantNoModels: No model allowed yet. Load the provider’s models or add one by its identifier.
assistantDiscoverNeedsKey: Enter the API key to load the models.
assistantDiscoverNeedsUrl: Enter the base URL to load the models.
assistantModelsNotListed: This server does not list its models. Add their identifiers below.
assistantModelsFound: {count} models available. Select those people can use.
assistantModelsEmpty: The provider returned no models. Add their identifiers below.
assistantDefaultHint: Conversations start with this model; people can switch to any allowed model.
assistantTestHint: Sends a short check prompt with the settings above, even unsaved. No project content is sent.
assistantEnabledHint: Shows the AI assistant button to every signed-in user once saved.
assistantEnableNeedsModel: Choose a default model before enabling the assistant.
assistantNoQuickPrompts: No quick prompts: conversations start without suggestions.
